tools.name: aa_targets
tools.description: List available devices and runtime instances, and the open child sessions created by this supervisor.

tools.name: aa_spawn
tools.description: Create a new Agents Anywhere session on a runtime instance (for example a Codex or Claude session) in a working directory and send it its first message. By default this session supervises it and is woken when it finishes a turn, fails, needs an approval or proposes a plan.

runtime.description: Runtime type (codex, claude, pi, dsh, hermes) when runtimeId is not given; the device's default instance of that type is used.

deviceId.description: Device to run on; default this device.

mode.description: plan: start in plan mode; goal: the prompt is the session goal.

triggers.description: When to wake this session about the target. Default: turn_end, turn_failed, notice_opened, plan_proposed, stalled.

projectId.description: Registered project on the target device matching cwd.

actionId.description: Optional retry key unique to this supervisor. Reuse only with identical arguments.

tools.name: aa_send
tools.description: Send a message to another session. If it is busy the message is queued and runs after its current turn.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

actionId.description: Optional retry key unique to this supervisor. Reuse only with identical arguments.

tools.name: aa_steer
tools.description: Give a running child a new instruction in its current turn. If the runtime cannot steer, use aa_send to queue a follow-up.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

actionId.description: Optional retry key unique to this supervisor. Reuse only with identical arguments.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

actionId.description: Optional retry key unique to this supervisor. Reuse only with identical arguments.

tools.name: aa_status
tools.description: Read the child status, timeline position, open notices, plan and goal state.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

tools.name: aa_read
tools.description: Read child timeline items after a sequence cursor. Set detail for longer text excerpts.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

afterSeq.description: Clock position to read after; default the last position this session read.

detail.description: Return item previews instead of a digest.

tools.name: aa_wait
tools.description: Wait up to 50 seconds for a child to settle or end its current turn. Returns the current status and a settled flag.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

tools.name: aa_close
tools.description: Close a session this session created and stop supervising it.

sessionId.description: The target session id (returned by aa_spawn or aa_targets).

deviceId.description: The target session's device; optional when the session is on this device or was created by this session.

actionId.description: Optional retry key unique to this supervisor. Reuse only with identical arguments.
